title: Strings that are a number once the underscores are removed
notes: Some readers remove every underscore from a plain scalar before they parse it as a number, so strings such as `+_1`, `1e3_` and `0_x123` read as numbers there, although the Core schema reads them as strings; the family quotes every string that is a number once its underscores are removed. The Core-schema reading (loose) is the specification. The reading under YAML 1.1 and the number forms that some common readers accept (strict) is a writing convention of the family: a string is written plain only when it reads as that same string there too.

provenance.reference: Strings such as +_1 and 1e3_ written without quotes; Go readers that strip underscores before parsing read them as numbers.
